title: dual-predication-hyperdoctrine
description: The Priestley-dual of a predication-hyperdoctrine, obtained by piecewise Jung-Rivieccio duality: fibers become paired-Priestley spectra, the fibration flips to an opfibration, the closure 2-monad becomes a dual closure 2-comonad, and the settling coalgebra becomes a settling algebra.

dualFibers.description: each fiber is Spec(A_q) in PairedPriSp - the Priestley dual of the predication-fiber-algebra A_q = L^bowtie^(E x E)

totalCategory.description: E* is the Grothendieck construction of the dualized fiberwise data over C^op

opfibration.description: p*: E* -> C^op is an opfibration; reindexing runs in the opposite direction in the fibers (contravariant Spec flips primal-fibration to dual-opfibration)

dualClosureComonad.description: Cl* is a colax-idempotent 2-comonad acting by restriction-to-confirming-Priestley-points; primal closure inflates a value in <=_k, dual closure shrinks the confirming point-set

settlingAlgebra.description: settling becomes an algebra c*: F_U*(E*) -> E* (dual of the primal settling coalgebra c: E -> F_U(E)); the <=_k-monotone primal orbit becomes a co-monotone shrinking dual orbit

adjointsCarryAcross.description: both quantifier adjoint triples, Frobenius, and Beck-Chevalley survive dualization because the two bilattice orders correspond to orthogonal directions (Priestley order and swap involution) on the paired Priestley space
